test_asof_partial: test the DatetimeIndex.asof method with a partial date string and verify it returns the expected Timestamp
test_asof_exact_boundary: test the DatetimeIndex.asof method with exact datetime values at start and end boundaries of the index
test_asof_datetime_string: test the DatetimeIndex.asof method with a date string key and verify correct result with non-midnight timestamps
test_asof_returns_timestamp: test that DatetimeIndex.asof returns a Timestamp instance when given a Python datetime object
test_asof_returns_nan: test that DatetimeIndex.asof returns NaN when the query date is before all dates in the index
